Eva Nielsen is a nursing director for the Region of Southern Denmark and a member of the steering group for the Danish National Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD) [^src1]. Her inclusion in the [[styregruppen-for-danibd|Styregruppen for DANIBD]] highlights the strategic role that nursing leadership plays in the database's quality assurance and governance work [^src1]. 

The steering group forms the institutional framework for DANIBD's operations, functioning as an interdisciplinary and regional body that includes doctors, nursing leaders, patient representatives, and experts from the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme [^src1]. Through her position, Nielsen helps guide a national registry that relies on the Danish National Patient Registry to maintain a validated coverage rate of over 90%, ultimately supporting quality measurement and benchmarking in Danish IBD care [^src1].
